title: Fuel Our Shared Future:
title_short: Comcast CTV :30 · Fuel Our Shared Future (QR)
headline: A young person’s potential is already inside her. Your $42 a month brings it out. Scan the code and give.
story: A 30-second TV spot that runs on Comcast streaming (Roku, Hulu, Tubi) in Manhattan from 1 Nov to 1 Dec. The viewers are adults who give. They watch on a TV with their phone in hand. The QR code sits in the corner from 0:03 to the end, so anyone who is moved can scan at once.

It is your V1, cut down to 30 s. Heart first: a student says what is inside her, we see young people pitch and win, the narrator asks the viewer to invest, three students say <q>Fuel a future like mine</q>, and the end card asks for $42 a month. NFTE asked us to spend the seconds on why it matters and why to give now, not on who NFTE is.

LOOPS: L1 <q>What is inside her?</q> opens 0:00, closes 00:06.4 when we see students pitch and win. L2 <q>Who gives her that support?</q> opens 0:00, closes in the BUTTON: the narrator’s <q>someone like you</q> and the girl from the hook asking us herself. STAKES: talent without support stays inside.
do: Start on Naije’e’s first word. Text is already on screen at frame 1.
Keep the QR code on from 00:03.0 to 00:23.0, lower right, untouched.
Hold the end card 7 s: the ask, the URL, the big code, NFTE | BUILD logos, the "Paid for by" line.
Cut on the music and on the narrator’s commas. Let real applause breathe.
Mix for TV: −24 LKFS, peaks at −8 dBTP or lower.
dont: No NFTE logo bug, no name card and no title before the end card.
No black frames, no fade to black, no slate. Picture on all 900 frames.
No red text. Brand colours only: purple, orange, white.
No city names. No shot where a sign reads a city.
Don’t go over 30 s. Not even one frame.
